Feature:

- Add Audio Trigger Recording example

- Add TensorFlowLite

- Add sound detector trigger example
- Update PowerMode examples and API to support multiple wakeup sources
- Add AMB82-zero
- Add I2C Slave
- Update I2C slave example guide links
- Update  SDCardOTA and SDCardPlayMP3
- Add support of PCA9685
- Add example Wire\examples\PCA9685\3PositionTest
- Add example Wire\examples\PCA9685\ServoSweep
- Add example SPI\examples\graphicstest
- Update OTA example for warnings
- Add USB Host UVC Snapshot

API Updates:
- Update code base
- Delete Arduino_package/hardware/libraries/POC-Example directory

- Add application level source code at "system" folder
- Add sensor K306P support
- Update WDT API
- Update codebase for ATcmd
- Update API for AMB82-zero and SWD off logic
- Update SPI API for SPI1 switching
- Add SWD pin deinit check for I2C
- Minor bug fix
- Update codebase
- Add Adafruits PWM Servo Driver library sources
- Minor bug fix
- Add Adafruit_libs
- Update OTA API
